comparison.measured_reference_pair_finding: Both reference launches concentrate their qualified Pump.fun impulse in one trading slot, but their structures differ sharply. WATCHTOWER embeds a creator seed buy and reaches migration with 85.005359057 SOL across five buyers. The Byzantine reference is creation-only, begins one slot later with seven independent buyers, receives 1.309602285 SOL, includes an intervening sell, and remains on the curve at first-slot end.
comparison.why: The distinction is creator-seeded immediate completion versus independent next-slot curve burst, not multi-slot versus single-slot. N=1 per operation cannot establish prevalence.
comparison.recommended_cross_operation_definition: Pump.fun curve-implied MC at the earliest defensible impulse endpoint: migration/completion when it occurs inside the burst, otherwise the last successful action before a qualified time/slot gap. Preserve first-buy MC, first-slot MC and migration MC separately.
